# Tru8 — Evidence Verification Infrastructure

> Verify the evidence behind factual AI output before it ships. Tru8 decomposes content into checkable claims, retrieves external published sources (30+: official data, research, legislation, reporting), classifies each by tier (primary/reporting/commentary) and type (data/official/news/analysis/opinion/academic), and maps every source to a claim element by relationship (supports/challenges/context). It returns a structured, inspectable, signed evidence record — never a verdict. We organize; you decide.

## What it returns

A verification record per claim:
- Elements — each claim broken into 1–5 checkable factual parts
- Evidence mapped to each element with a relationship (supports / challenges / context) and a one-line reason
- Element states, plus named gaps (what evidence is missing)
- Exclusion receipts — every source set aside carries a reason; no silent curation
- Source-diversity metrics — unique domains, tier spread, type coverage; echo/corroboration detection
- A signed manifest (HMAC-SHA256) with a /verify endpoint to confirm the signed fields haven't changed since signing

You decide what to publish, escalate, re-check or block.

## API

Base: https://api.trueight.com/api/v1/agent
Auth: X-API-Key header
Docs: https://www.trueight.com/developers
Compare: https://www.trueight.com/compare — capability comparison vs search/grounding, eval/guardrail, and fact-checking tools, with live response captures
Pricing: https://www.trueight.com/pricing — current rates per tier

Tiers (depth and cost increase down the list):
- POST /agent/lookup — cached prior record, instant
- Consensus — privacy-preserving cross-user aggregate (via /agent/check with max_tier=consensus)
- POST /agent/quick — web search + heuristic classification, ~15s
- POST /agent/full — full pipeline, web + specialist APIs, ~60–90s
- POST /agent/check — smart endpoint, automatic tier fallback (lookup → consensus → quick → full)
- GET /agent/result/{id} — retrieve a completed record (free)
- POST /agent/batch — up to 10 claims (async)

Payment: prepaid credits, x402 (USDC/SIWE), or Skyfire (JWT)

## MCP Server

Package: tru8-mcp (Python, PyPI)
Tools: tru8_check (with max_tier param), tru8_get_result, tru8_get_result_raw
Compatible with Claude, GPT, Gemini, and any MCP-capable agent.

## Human console

Tru8 Console — https://www.trueight.com/research — the same evidence record in a browser, with six ways to read it: the classified evidence set, a citation map, a publication timeline, source diversity, named gaps, and on-camera video context.
